Hope you're well — we met briefly at the Inference Workshop in April. Aurora Analytics is running the technical track at DataSummit (Sept 14-15) and we're putting together a hands-on "Tech Lab" focused on inference at scale. Given Redwood's work on serving runtimes, we think a joint lab would be a strong fit — mix of 60–90 minutes: 20–25 minute talk + 40–60 minute guided lab/demo + 10 minute QA.

High-level asks from us:
- Co-present a short talk on production trade-offs (latency vs cost) and an end-to-end demo (Redwood runtime + Aurora observability + BrightOps tooling).
- Support for a 30-seat lab environment (we'll help with infra).
- Co-marketing: a co-authored blog, social amplification, and a shared listing on DataSummit site.
- Sponsor fee (covers room + infra) — term sheet attached, hope we can split.

I've attached a one-pager and a draft agenda for your review (tech-lab-proposal.pdf, draft-agenda.md). Can we put a quick 30-minute sync on calendar next week to lock speakers and budget?

If this is of interest I can loop in the DataSummit organizer to confirm space and get the official listing.

Thanks — excited about the potential.

Best,
Hugo
Head of Partnerships, Aurora Analytics
